standard_prerequisites: Chapter lemma-lift-maps (delivered card L48358, item 2): if L over K is normal algebraic, every K-algebra map from an intermediate extension M into L extends to an automorphism of L
Chapter lemma-characterize-normal (source lemma): normality is equivalent to all K-embeddings of the extension into a common overfield having one and the same image
core_obligations: Given tau and tau-prime, both K-embeddings of L into E, normality (conjugate-fields characterization) gives tau-prime(L) = tau(L): replace L by the common image inside E
Then sigma = tau-inverse composed with tau-prime is a K-algebra map from L to L, that is from the intermediate extension M = L of the normal extension L over K
By lift-maps item 2, sigma extends to an automorphism of L; since M = L the extension coincides with sigma itself, so sigma is in Aut(L over K) and tau-prime = tau composed with sigma
proof_roadmap: Force the two embedding images to coincide through normality
Turn the comparison map into an automorphism via the lift lemma
